echo '=== expand subspace ==='; python3 - <<'EOF'
def expand(k): return (k ^ ((k<<16)&0xffffffff) ^ (k*12345)) & 0xffffffff
basis=[]
for i in range(20):
    v=expand(1<<i)
    x=v
    for b in basis:
        x=min(x,x^b)
    if x:
        basis.append(x); basis.sort(reverse=True)
print('rank',len(basis),[hex(b) for b in basis])
# row-reduced pivot positions
rows=basis[:]
piv=[]; r=0
for col in range(31,-1,-1):
    p=next((i for i in range(r,len(rows)) if (rows[i]>>col)&1),None)
    if p is None: continue
    rows[r],rows[p]=rows[p],rows[r]
    for i in range(len(rows)):
        if i!=r and ((rows[i]>>col)&1): rows[i]^=rows[r]
    piv.append(col); r+=1
    if r==len(rows): break
print('pivots',piv)
print('free',[c for c in range(32) if c not in piv])
for rr in rows: print(hex(rr))
EOF
